capabilities: Detect and wrap bare LaTeX formulas in $ delimiters
Skip frontmatter, code blocks, inline code, links, wikilinks and existing math
Convert a selection, the current note or the whole vault
Check the result before writing and abort if the note would break
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX document or format converter; it only rewrites LaTeX delimiters and wraps undelimited formulas inside Markdown notes.
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English README; installation is described as copying main.js and manifest.json into the plugin folder rather than through the community plugin browser. No network access, telemetry, account or paid tier.
motivation: Convert messy AI-generated LaTeX into something Obsidian's MathJax actually renders, including formulas that have no delimiters at all.
problem: AI-generated notes often contain LaTeX with non-Obsidian delimiters or no delimiters at all, so Obsidian's MathJax does not render the formulas.
summary: Converts \( \) and \[ \] LaTeX delimiters to $ and $$ and wraps undelimited LaTeX formulas, leaving tables, code and links untouched.
